html.Pour toute question sur vos données pers: For any question about your personal data, email us at contact@bikentour.com. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).
html.Cookies utilisés sur bikentour.com : auc: Cookies used on bikentour.com: no advertising cookies, audience measurement only with your consent. Manage or withdraw your consent.
html.Le vélo est la meilleure façon de découv: A bike is the best way to discover Nantes: the historic centre, the Île de Nantes and the banks of the Loire are linked by cycle paths, and in two hours you see more than a whole day on foot would allow.
html.Avec l'assistance électrique, personne n: With electric assistance nobody struggles: teenagers, grandparents and keen cyclists all ride at the same pace. Your guide sets up your bike before you start and shows you how to use it.
html.Nos guides vivent à Nantes. Ils raconten: Our guides live in Nantes. They tell the story of the city, from the Dukes of Brittany to the Machines de l'île, and share their favourite places so you can carry on exploring.
html.Famille, amis, collègues : nous organiso: Family, friends or colleagues: we organise your tour at the time that suits you.
